description: This file defines the 'Authorize' controller class within the Opencart e-commerce system. It manages user authorization processes such as redirecting logged-in users, handling two-factor authentication (2FA), and controlling access to certain routes based on auth tokens and config settings.

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing user authorization and 2FA related redirect logic within the OpenCart storefront.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that checks current route, authorization tokens, 2FA status, and redirects users accordingly based on configuration and login state.
